name: Zallax's Emerald 3DS Voxels (ported by Ceedrack)
description: Emerald only. Zallax's Emerald 3DS voxel overworld (github.com/ZallaxDev/emerald-3ds, used with permission, MIT), ported by Ceedrack: buildings and rooms modelled from their own drawing, terrain relief, pixel-voxel signposts and its tilted-plane trees, under the original's camera and baked sunlight, and its 3D battles over the world. No ROM data ships with it: the models are generated from your own ROM with bake/bake.py. Registers one render pipeline, E3DS 3D (OFF and the five 3D ANGLE rungs), on hotkey 0. Presentational only.
